vendors.name: SAP BusinessObjects BI
vendors.tagline: The long-running enterprise BI suite from SAP. Universes are its semantic layer.
vendors.verdictNote: Universes (.unx) are a classic governed semantic layer. BusinessObjects has no first-party NL-to-SQL, synonym or MCP feature. SAP puts its AI work into Business Data Cloud.

artifacts.name: Universe (.unx) built in Information Design Tool
Universe (.unv) built in Universe Design Tool
SAP Business Data Cloud shared semantic layer and HANA Cloud knowledge graph

metrics.n: The business layer of a universe holds measures. They map to SQL expressions on the data foundation.

dimensions.n: The business layer holds dimensions, hierarchies and attributes. Web Intelligence queries pick these objects.

relationships.n: The data foundation declares joins. The tool can detect or set join cardinality.

synonyms.n: No synonym or AI context object exists for universes. Teams use object descriptions or an outside layer.

verifiedQueries.n: Universes have no example query or trusted question store. Teams keep curated Web Intelligence documents instead.

nl2sql.n: BusinessObjects has no first-party NL-to-SQL. SAP Joule agents depend on Business Data Cloud.

ontology.n: BusinessObjects has none. The SAP knowledge graph engine sits in HANA Cloud and Business Data Cloud.

mcp.n: SAP has no MCP server. CData sells a third-party MCP server for BusinessObjects BI. It uses the JDBC driver of CData.

governance.n: Admins can secure universes with data and business security profiles. They set the profiles in the Information Design Tool.

openStandard.n: No OSI or Ossie export exists. Universes (.unx) are a proprietary format. Other tools write them only through the Semantic Layer Java SDK of SAP.

offers: BI 2025 still supports single-source .unx universes with dimensions, measures and joins.
Web Intelligence builds queries on a universe, so business users avoid raw SQL.
Security profiles restrict universe data and objects per user or group.
BI platform REST services list universes and Web Intelligence documents.
BI 4.3 mainstream maintenance ends in 2026. Then Customer Specific Maintenance starts.
gaps: BusinessObjects has no first-party NL-to-SQL, synonyms, verified queries or MCP server.
BI 2025 does not deliver the Universe Design Tool and .unv universes. Only .unx from Information Design Tool continues.
BI 2025 also does not deliver multi-source universes, per the SAP statement of direction.
SAP puts its AI and semantic investment into Business Data Cloud, not the BusinessObjects universe.
vendors.nl2sqlPath: BusinessObjects has no native NL-to-SQL. Teams that need an AI agent usually read the warehouse or an outside semantic layer instead of the universe. If the data is in SAP, look at Business Data Cloud and Joule. They are separate products.

vendors.name: IBM Cognos Analytics
vendors.tagline: IBM enterprise BI suite with data modules and an AI Assistant.
vendors.verdictNote: Data modules are a governed model, and the AI Assistant answers questions on them. IBM offers no verified queries and no official MCP server.

artifacts.name: Third-party Cognos MCP server (Activepieces, not IBM)

metrics.n: Data modules hold reusable calculations and filtered measures. The Usage property marks a column as a measure.

dimensions.n: Users model dimensions as tables or views with column dependency. This defines grains and hierarchies.

relationships.n: Relationships carry cardinality. Release 12.1.1 added a relationship expression editor and a Use vs Display value option.

synonyms.n: The Assistant reads column labels and synonyms. Authors add each synonym as a calculation in a folder under the column.

nl2sql.n: The AI Assistant answers natural-language questions. It builds visualizations and dashboards from governed data.

ontology.n: Data modules have no ontology or business entity layer. They model tables, columns, calculations and relationships.

graph.n: Data modules and the Assistant have no graph query feature.

mcp.n: Release 12.1.3 adds the Cognos Analytics MCP server, an IBM program. Its tools cover administration, configuration, data and content.

governance.n: IBM lists certified data models, fine-grained access controls and audit trails. The assistant answers from governed data.

openStandard.n: No open semantic export exists. Cognos does not appear on the Apache Ossie ecosystem page.

offers: Data modules take relationship expressions and display-value settings (12.1.1, Oct 2025).
The AI Assistant answers natural-language questions from any Cognos view.
Users can build modules from reusable dimension and fact modules. Aliases serve role-playing tables.
IBM names 12.1.3 as its latest release. It has conversational data interaction and reporting agents.
gaps: No official MCP server exists. Only a third-party wrapper and an IBM Ideas request exist.
Teams on 11.2 and 12.0 reported weak Assistant results on large models with similar column names.
Users set synonyms per model. Teams reported that sharing them across modules is unsupported in 11.2.3.
Reporting agents were Preview in 12.1.1. IBM does not state their stage in 12.1.3.
vendors.nl2sqlPath: Model the data in a data module. Define unique item names and synonyms. Use the built-in AI Assistant for end users. For your own agents, the only MCP path is a third-party wrapper, so test it carefully. Check the IBM 12.1.3 notes before you commit.

vendors.name: Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy)
vendors.tagline: BI vendor whose Mosaic universal semantic layer feeds agents and MCP clients.
vendors.verdictNote: Mosaic is a GA semantic layer with agents, an MCP server for Mosaic models, and Apache Ossie YAML import and export.

artifacts.name: Mosaic import and export as Apache Ossie YAML
Git version control for Mosaic models (GitHub only)

metrics.n: Mosaic YAML defines fact metrics and derived metrics with aggregation, formulas and formatting.

dimensions.n: Attributes, hierarchies and relationships between attributes define grouping and roll-up.

relationships.n: Hierarchy and relationship definitions are part of the model. Users can link Mosaic models to each other.

synonyms.n: Agent column descriptions hold aliases and business logic. Auto knowledge assets take glossaries, acronyms and synonyms.

verifiedQueries.n: No verified-query object exists. Agents use custom instructions with SQL examples and column descriptions instead.

nl2sql.n: Agents answer questions on AI-enabled Mosaic models. They use the metrics and relationships in the model. GA since Dec 2025.

ontology.n: Strategy announced AI-generated ontologies at Strategy World in Feb 2026. They are not released.

graph.n: The Mosaic and agent docs show no graph query language.

vector.n: The release notes show no vector search over data or metadata.

mcp.n: Mosaic models are in the MCP server out of the box from March 2026. This replaces a Feb 2026 preview. Models must be certified.

governance.n: Mosaic YAML carries security filters and ACLs. MCP queries use only published, certified models that the user can view.

openStandard.n: Mosaic imports and exports Apache Ossie YAML. It was Preview in Jun 2026 and is available out of the box from Jul 2026.

offers: Mosaic serves JDBC, XMLA and DAX for Power BI, REST and Python. It also has a Tableau connector.
The Mosaic MCP endpoint returns projects, models, semantic definitions and read-only SQL results (Trino dialect).
Users can exchange models as Apache Ossie YAML and version them in GitHub.
Agents read column descriptions and custom instructions. Tuning files can be reused across agents.
Mosaic Studio can import Databricks Unity Catalog and BigQuery descriptions. It can generate business-friendly names.
gaps: AI-generated ontologies are announced only.
Git support starts with GitHub only. It allows one integration per environment.
Ossie import keeps only ANSI SQL expressions and assumes one-to-many relationships. It loses time granularity on round trips.
No verified-query object exists. Agent tuning versions that test custom instructions are Preview.
vendors.nl2sqlPath: Build the model in Mosaic. Certify it. Turn on AI for it. Let agents answer in Strategy tools. For outside agents, connect Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot to the Mosaic MCP endpoint. Use the Ossie YAML export when you need to move definitions elsewhere.

vendors.name: Qlik (Qlik Sense and Qlik Cloud)
vendors.tagline: Associative analytics platform with logical models, Qlik Answers, and an MCP server.
vendors.verdictNote: Logical models, business logic synonyms, glossary links and Qlik Answers feed AI. The Qlik MCP server reached GA in Feb 2026.

artifacts.name: Logical model and business logic (vocabulary, synonyms)
Qlik Answers generated field and master item descriptions (semantic understanding)
Discovery Agent and Data Products for Analytics

metrics.n: Qlik Answers indexes master measures first. Fast Mode uses them. MCP tools create and update them.

dimensions.n: Fast Mode uses master dimensions. The logical model adds groups, hierarchies and calendar periods.

relationships.n: Logical model groups show conceptual association between fields and master items. Qlik Answers reads the Overview and Fields tabs.

synonyms.n: Business logic vocabulary maps alternate terms. Answers generates field descriptions that you can edit. Glossary terms link to master items.

verifiedQueries.n: No verified-query store exists. Vocabulary custom analyses and example questions are the closest match.

nl2sql.n: Qlik Answers on apps reached GA in Feb 2026. Fast Mode for simple lookups went live in Jun 2026.

ontology.n: None exists. Business glossary terms and data products exist, but no ontology layer.

vector.n: Knowledge base search exists for documents. The docs show no vector search over app data or metadata.

mcp.n: Qlik MCP server GA Feb 2026. It needs the Qlik MCP: Allowed permission. Admins can enable tools per tenant.

governance.n: Qlik Answers respects Section Access. MCP tools run as the connecting user. A lineage tool exists.

openStandard.n: Qlik joined the Open Semantic Interchange effort. The docs show no Qlik export of the logical model.

offers: The logical model and vocabulary supply synonyms and custom analyses to Insight Advisor.
Qlik Answers generates field and master item descriptions you can review and edit.
The Qlik MCP server lets outside assistants search apps, read fields, apply selections and run ad hoc calculations.
MCP tools cover glossary, data products, lineage, master items and selections.
Section Access limits what Qlik Answers returns.
gaps: No verified-query or example-SQL object exists.
Each app has a single logical model, so it is not a shared governed model across apps.
Qlik joined the standard but has no export of the logical model to Ossie.
Qlik announced Discovery Agent and Data Products for Analytics for after Feb 2026. Their current status is not confirmed.
vendors.nl2sqlPath: Define master measures and dimensions. Set up the logical model and vocabulary. Then let Qlik Answers index the app. For your own agents, connect to the Qlik MCP server and enable only the tools you need. Plan for one logical model per app when you think about reuse.

vendors.name: Oracle Analytics Cloud and Server
vendors.tagline: Oracle BI platform with a code-based semantic model, AI Assistant, and an MCP server in Preview.
vendors.verdictNote: The semantic model (Semantic Modeler, SMML JSON, Git) feeds the AI Assistant through indexing, synonyms and AI Descriptions. The MCP server is still Preview.

artifacts.name: Search Index: AI Assistant indexing, synonyms and AI Descriptions
Analytic Views support in Semantic Modeler

metrics.n: Logical columns carry aggregation rules. The logical layer holds measures, level-based measures and calculations.

dimensions.n: Logical levels, level-based and parent-child hierarchies and drill paths are part of the model.

relationships.n: The physical layer holds joins and aliases. Logical tables carry joins with mapped table sources.

synonyms.n: Admins set synonyms, indexing and AI Descriptions per column in the Search Index. CSV export allows bulk edits.

verifiedQueries.n: No verified-query object exists. AI Descriptions add business context per column instead.

nl2sql.n: The AI Assistant reuses indexed datasets and subject areas and answers in natural language.

vector.n: The docs show no vector search. The AI Assistant uses a metadata and value index.

mcp.n: The OAC MCP server is Preview. It has tools to search the catalog, describe data and run ANSI or Logical SQL. It was first listed in Nov 2025.

governance.n: MCP tools run with the permissions of the user of the token. Sensitive Data indexing limits values to users with column access.

openStandard.n: The model is JSON (SMML) with Git support. Semantic Modeler has no Ossie or OSI export.

offers: The Search Index lets admins choose which attributes the AI Assistant sees. It has synonyms, AI Descriptions and metadata-only or value indexing.
Semantic Modeler stores models as JSON (SMML) files with Git integration.
MCP tools search the catalog, find matching data sources for a question, describe columns and run ANSI SQL or Logical SQL.
AI Descriptions state units, formats and aggregation rules for the assistant (Sep 2026).
Semantic Modeler supports Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Oracle databases and Analytic Views.
gaps: The MCP server is Preview. Oracle warns that its behavior may change. A tool (discover_data) is already deprecated.
The AI Assistant has no verified-query object.
Databricks is not in the Semantic Modeler data source table.
No Ossie or OSI converter or open export exists.
vendors.nl2sqlPath: Build the model in Semantic Modeler. Then enable attributes, synonyms and AI Descriptions in the Search Index so the AI Assistant can use them. For outside agents, use the Preview MCP server and keep its permissions narrow. Do not depend on it for production until it is GA.

notes.text: The May 2024 statement of direction from SAP says BI 2025 does not deliver Universe Design Tool, .unv universes or multi-source universes. It planned BI 2027 for Q4 2026. Wiiisdom (Feb 2026) says BI 4.3 mainstream maintenance ends in 2026. Customer Specific Maintenance follows, with security fixes in the first 12 months. The status of BI 2027 is not confirmed.

The 2021 addendum from SAP tied the end of .unv and Universe Design Tool support to the end of BI 4.3 maintenance, end of 2027. The 2024 direction from SAP says .unx universes cover all .unv use cases. It also says SAP tools support migration to .unx. Wiiisdom says .unv is not supported after BI 4.3.
The list shown comes from the connections named in the Information Design Tool guide of SAP. The full list is in the Product Availability Matrix of SAP. That matrix needs an SAP login.

The IBM product page calls 12.1.3 the latest release. It says reporting agents and conversational data interaction arrive with it. GenAI agents were Preview in 12.1.1 (Oct 2025). The IBM docs pages were not readable, so several data module details rely on IBM Community posts.
No IBM MCP server exists. A third-party Activepieces MCP server (updated Sep 2026) exposes data source and content object actions. An IBM Ideas request from Jun 2026 asks for an official server.

IBM publishes its supported data source list as compatibility reports. The list shown is limited to the SAP BW/4HANA and Microsoft Fabric connectors named in the 12.1.1 release post. IBM also documents a Snowflake data source setup.

MicroStrategy is now Strategy. Mosaic went GA Jun 24, 2025. Mosaic in the MCP server shipped out of the box on Mar 20, 2026. This replaced a Feb 2026 preview. An admin enables the MCP server itself once per environment. From Sep 2026 separate privileges control the Agent and Mosaic MCP servers. Use Mosaic MCP Server is off by default after an upgrade.

Import and export of Apache Ossie YAML was a Preview in Strategy One June 2026. It is available out of the box from the July 2026 release (release note dated Jul 17, 2026). Only ANSI SQL expressions import. Relationships import as one-to-many. Time granularity is lost on a round trip. October 2026 converts unknown database functions to pass-through expressions.
OSI is now Apache Ossie (Incubating). The Ossie ecosystem page describes Strategy Mosaic import and export. It also lists Qlik and Oracle among participants. The Qlik and Oracle docs show no export.

Qlik announced GA of its agentic experience, Qlik Answers and the MCP server in Feb 2026. Discovery Agent and Data Products for Analytics were to follow. Fast Mode for Qlik Answers on structured data went live Jun 7, 2026. Qlik MCP tools now include lineage, glossary, data product and master item tools.

notes.topic: Oracle MCP stage and tool names
notes.text: The Sep 2026 developer guide from Oracle still labels the OAC MCP server Preview. It first appeared in the Nov 2025 update. Tool names changed. The oracle_analytics-discover_data tool is deprecated, and search_catalog replaces it. Oracle added ANSI SQL execution.

notes.topic: Oracle Analytic Views in Semantic Modeler
notes.text: The Jan 2026 update added Analytic Views to Semantic Modeler. The supported data source table now lists Oracle Analytic Views as supported in both Semantic Modeler and the Model Administration Tool.

notes.topic: Oracle AI Assistant and AI Descriptions
notes.text: The AI Assistant docs carry no preview label. AI Descriptions for datasets and subject area columns appear in the Sep 2026 What's New. The Oracle docs list Databricks as a remote data source through Data Gateway. They do not list it in the Semantic Modeler table.
